entry.title: I went relatively early this morning.
Taking a Fine-Toothed Comb to a Vibe-Coded Lightroom Clone
entry.summary: I spent a week having Claude Code audit my fork of LightCraft, the AI-built Rust Lightroom clone: fuzzing, crash safety, a locked control port, faster frames, and 50,000 deleted lines.

entry.title: The Ballmer Peak in the Age of AI Coding
entry.summary: During the years when I was doing a lot of hands-on coding, roughly from 1998 to 2010, I lived by the rule of what xkcd comic author Randall Munroe named the “ Ballmer Peak ” after Steve Ballmer, the former CEO of Microsoft who was known for his exuberant and sweaty appearance on stage .

entry.title: Digital permanence and me Conceptually a URL shortener is a useful idea. A shorter url is simpler to speak aloud, to paste into an email without it breaking, to add to social media and not use too many characters.
